name: SlipNet
desc: Android VPN client with DNS tunneling (DNSTT, NoizDNS & Slipstream), NaiveProxy, SSH, Tor, and DoH support — featuring a built-in DNS scanner.
descFull: Android VPN client with DNS tunneling (DNSTT, NoizDNS & Slipstream), NaiveProxy, SSH, Tor, and DoH support — featuring a built-in DNS scanner.
